protocol.study: Nested complete-state learning curve, exact expectations
protocol.predeclaration: Design fixed before running any smaller-size training or inspecting their test errors
protocol.nested_subsets: One family-balanced state ordering, shared by every model and optimizer seed
protocol.validation: All 96 recorded validation pairs, unchanged at every training size

quantum.selection: minimum validation MSE among initial and every-fifth-iteration checkpoints

film.checkpoint_selection: minimum validation MSE, checked at initialization and every iteration
film.configuration_selection: minimum mean validation MSE across all three seeds, independently at each size
film.input: 15 exact nonidentity two-qubit Pauli expectations and context vector

protocol.calibration: Exact untrained classical Gram formula; no fitted coefficients or labeled pairs required
protocol.primary_endpoint: test_joint MSE: fixed new states and held-out context cap
protocol.test_context_caveat: At smaller sizes some original test_context states are absent from training; overlap counts are in indices.json
protocol.reported_uncertainty: All three optimizer seeds, arithmetic mean and range; no dataset-resampling confidence interval
protocol.reuse_policy: Only pinned identical source/data/results and matching training configurations; saved checkpoint predictions are reevaluated
protocol.resource_scope: Counts are labeled source-state/context pairs, not physical quantum copies or measurement shots
protocol.runtime_scope: Per-run training times and new invocation wall time; reused training times remain historical
claims: No practical superiority is inferred from errors near numerical precision
A matched two-copy quantum model is a strong comparator
The known classical Gram formula is exact with exact Pauli features
One nested state sequence and three optimizer seeds are a diagnostic, not a general sample-complexity theorem

fit.batching: full-dataset exact objective; chunk gradients accumulated before each optimizer update
fit.selection_rule: minimum validation MSE among checkpoints; no test-based selection
fit.parameter_domain: real angles and affine-head parameters; physical eta/chi coefficients use trigonometric parametrization

architecture.name: joint_exchange
architecture.output_heads: P(c) on both output registers; same execution
architecture.conditioner: shared learned Euler frame, 4 scale/offset parameters
architecture.input_preprocessing: no exact query alignment; learned frame is part of V(c)
architecture.readout: learned affine combination of both port means
architecture.chi_realization: classical random choice of exchange sign, no postselection
architecture.resource_note: Global register partial-SWAP is not a product of pair partial-SWAPs. Fredkin decomposition is not compiled or costed as a CNOT here.
architecture.training: actual PennyLane QNodes, Torch backpropagation, torch.optim.LBFGS (optional Adam warmup)
architecture.identifiability: a,b and affine-head scale are not separately physical estimates

backend.differentiation: backpropagation through actual parameterized PennyLane gates
backend.mixed_state_representation: Exact positive-square-root purification; eigenvectors are input preparation only and never used as learned features
backend.batching: Native PennyLane StatePrep and gate-parameter broadcasting
backend.signed_mixture: Two actual QNode branches, averaged with cos(chi/2)^2 and sin(chi/2)^2
backend.physical_resource_note: Purification environments are simulator bookkeeping and do not change raw-copy or physical data-gate counts. On hardware the sign mixture randomly selects one exchange sign for each prepared pair.
backend.compatibility_note: Public-API purification avoids the batched QubitDensityMatrix initialization bug observed in default.mixed in PennyLane 0.45.1
